question: What is Inner Monologue in Moshi, and what does it improve?
final_text: In Section 3.4.4, the authors introduce Inner Monologue, a new training and inference setup for audio language models that significantly improves the factuality and linguistic quality of generated speech by predicting time‑aligned text tokens before audio tokens [MOSHI:1:c007]. The most striking result is the impact of Inner Monologue on Moshi’s performance, almost tripling its accuracy on all benchmarks, and significantly improving over previous work [MOSHI:5.5:c091]. This improvement comes while Inner Monologue only marginally increases inference cost (each multi‑stream timestep requires generating 17 tokens, instead of 16 without Inner Monologue) [MOSHI:5.5:c091]. The authors also state that the most drastic improvement to the quality and length of generated speech comes from enabling Inner Monologue [MOSHI:5.3:c083]. The retrieved passages do not state the exact architectural changes introduced by Inner Monologue.
